# P1 · Front desk and appointments MVP — R1 · Front Desk

**Window:** Weeks 4–10 · 16 Nov 2026 → 01 Jan 2027  
**Delivered to:** Receptionists, doctors (schedule view) and owners at 2 design-partner clinics  
**Day one:** Register patients, book, reschedule and cancel appointments, check patients in, run the waiting room and send automatic confirmations and reminders.  
**Goal:** A clinic can run its entire appointment day in Medvya. This is the workflow to validate with real clinics before anything clinical is built on top.

**Tickets:** 71 · **Estimate:** 160.5 dev-days vs **35 working days** in the window (OVER by 125.5 days: needs scope trade-off or overlap) · **Average confidence:** 78%

**Status:** To do 43 · Partly done 16 · Done 12

## Epics

| Epic | Title | Requirements | Goal |
|---|---|---|---|
| MDV-P1-E01 | Public site | P1-01 | Landing, region/residency selector, trust centre and demo request on the Razor public site. |
| MDV-P1-E02 | Clinic onboarding and practice settings | P1-02, P1-12 | A clinic or hospital applies through an onboarding request (ADR-016) and, once approved, sets up the practice, hours, holidays, notifications and legal terms. |
| MDV-P1-E03 | Doctors, staff and staff lifecycle | P1-03, P1-11 | Owners add doctors (licence they attest, signature, schedule) and staff (roles, scope); access ends immediately on offboarding. |
| MDV-P1-E04 | Schedules and availability | P1-04 | Working hours, breaks, slot lengths, leave and exceptions per doctor and location. |
| MDV-P1-E05 | Patient registration, duplicates and consents | P1-05, P1-12 | Register India and UAE patients quickly and safely, with separate versioned consents and no silent duplicates. |
| MDV-P1-E06 | Booking and no double booking | P1-06, P1-07 | Create, move, cancel and track appointments with database-guaranteed slot integrity. |
| MDV-P1-E07 | Reception board and queue | P1-08 | Run the waiting room: check-in, statuses, call/room, multi-doctor overview and TV display. |
| MDV-P1-E08 | Confirmations, reminders and notification centre | P1-09 | Email/SMS confirmations and reminders with delivery status; in-app notification centre. |
| MDV-P1-E09 | Practice access log | P1-10 | Owners see who opened which record and when. |
| MDV-P1-E10 | Pilot readiness and R1 gate | P1-01, P1-12 | External dependencies, production tenants, training, baselines, security review and the R1 exit gate. |
| MDV-P1-E11 | Connectivity and resilience | P1-06, P1-08 | The desk keeps working on flaky Indian connections: safe retries, timeouts, offline assets and a paper fallback; nothing with patient data is stored in the browser without a decision. |

## Exit criteria (release gate)

- [ ] Both clinics run 2 consecutive weeks of real bookings without paper fallback — [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] 0 double bookings with 100 parallel attempts on one slot — [MDV-P1-022](MDV-P1-022.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] Median check-in ≤ 60 s for a returning patient — [MDV-P1-028](MDV-P1-028.md), [MDV-P1-041](MDV-P1-041.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] ≥ 98% reminders delivered; failures visible to reception — [MDV-P1-032](MDV-P1-032.md), [MDV-P1-033](MDV-P1-033.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] No open high or critical security findings — [MDV-P1-038](MDV-P1-038.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)

**Not in this phase:** Clinical notes, prescriptions, billing, AI, patient portal.
